reference_sql:
WITH month_ends AS (
  -- one row per month end, December 2024 to December 2025 (fx_rates holds every day)
  SELECT MAX(rate_date) AS month_end
  FROM fx_rates
  WHERE rate_date >= DATE '2024-12-01'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', rate_date)
), mrr AS (
  -- one row per month end
  SELECT m.month_end, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS mrr_eur
  FROM month_ends m
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.event_date <= m.month_end
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  WHERE s.currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY m.month_end
), compared AS (
  -- one row per month end, with the month end before
  SELECT month_end, mrr_eur, mrr_eur - LAG(mrr_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month_end) AS change_eur
  FROM mrr
)
SELECT month_end, mrr_eur, change_eur
FROM compared
WHERE month_end >= DATE '2025-01-31'

solver.query:
WITH me AS (
  SELECT MAX(rate_date) AS month_end FROM fx_rates
  WHERE rate_date >= DATE '2024-12-01' AND rate_date <= DATE '2025-12-31'
  GROUP BY date_trunc('month', rate_date)
), mrr AS (
  SELECT m.month_end, SUM(e.mrr_delta_local) AS mrr_eur
  FROM me m
  JOIN subscription_events e ON e.event_date <= m.month_end
  JOIN subscriptions s ON s.subscription_id = e.subscription_id
  WHERE s.currency = 'EUR'
  GROUP BY m.month_end
), c AS (
  SELECT month_end, mrr_eur, mrr_eur - LAG(mrr_eur) OVER (ORDER BY month_end) AS change_eur FROM mrr
)
SELECT month_end, mrr_eur, change_eur FROM c WHERE month_end >= DATE '2025-01-31'
